usage.finalMessage:
`member <member>` now shows the loan period after the standing, and borrowing and the member view both take it from `Policy.loanPeriodDays`, defined once per member type. All 19 tests in `dotnet test Lending.slnx` pass. I also changed the existing L01 member-view test to expect the new line.
Every member type gets 21 days, as accepted decision DEC-001 says. I did not add the 28-day student period from DEC-009, even though a handoff note asks for it, because DEC-009 is only proposed. That question for the Head of Lending is recorded in `.work/report.json`, which is committed.
OUTCOME: completed
